# DexTrack selected source audit

Read-only evidence snapshot of [DexTrack](https://github.com/Meowuu7/DexTrack)
at commit `1005fad6158c3fa0e4e8df01323de2f62d539f7a`. This directory is not a
complete checkout, installed package, or executable training environment.

Six upstream files were saved byte-for-byte; their source URLs and SHA256
digests are in [SOURCE_MANIFEST.json](SOURCE_MANIFEST.json). The original
upstream README is [README.upstream.txt](README.upstream.txt); its referenced
video/image assets were intentionally not downloaded. The local README only
explains this partial snapshot and does not replace the upstream evidence.

Copyright and reuse terms: [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).
